method: Only description is passed to inference. Labels, language and scenarios are evaluation metadata. Frozen model probabilities and thresholds are reused through the normal classifier and ticket analysis.
interpretation: Standalone labeled benchmark. Dataset provenance must be assessed separately.

decisions.description: At the vegetable row, the seller has no current vendor ID. Separately, the helper left boxes on the stairs leading to the upper level.
Ibinenentang 2 kilo ang hipon pero tinimbang na 1840 gramo. Dumura ang katulong sa tabi ng pagkain na nakahanda sa mesa.
Binunot ni seller yung freezer ng katabing vendor habang wala siya. Bukod dito, walang SRP card sa display ng bigas.
The operator had not reported a roof leak for three days. In addition, the operator tied the shared faucet open with wire and left it running.
The poultry dealer's meat dealer license names a different stall. Separately, the seller's flyers told shoppers to avoid the named business across the aisle.
The lead seal on the merchant's scale was missing. The seller announced a buyer's overdue debt to the people in line.
Lasing ang tindero at binasag niya ang isang bote. Natigil ang bentahan sa hanay. Walang vendor ID ang isa pang nagtitinda.
Nag-stack si vendor ng crates sa rampa, kumitid kaya di makadaan yung wheelchair. May ipis sa counter na may nilutong ulam.
Stallholders must remove stock from the shared cold room by 7 PM. The seller's tubs were still in the shared cold room at 8:20 PM. Also, the seller displayed no SRP card for corn.
The seller would not serve a buyer because of her religious attire. The seller also called the inspector posing as the administrator to cancel the inspection.
The merchant used six bulbs despite the stall limit of two light points. Separately, the approved produce stall was being used as a private office despite the restriction to sales.
The stallholder failed to pay rent for four months despite a final demand. The stallholder also built a fixed storage wall without obtaining construction approval.
A vendor sold eggs by the loading ramp with no vending authorization. A delivery truck drove the wrong way on the marked one-way service road.
The vendor sold a glass of gin to a sixteen-year-old. During the same inspection, the food handler packed ready-to-eat meals with bare hands despite the disposable glove rule.
Nagbenta ng mga itak ang tindero kahit sa lisensiyadong hardware lang ito puwede. Bukod dito, naupo sa daanan ang mga tindero bilang protesta at tumigil ang bentahan.
A porter refused to show the required rate card before accepting the delivery. The stallholder has unpaid daily parking fees for five consecutive days.
The operator held the raffle a week ahead of the advertised date without notice. The operator fastened the sale banner to the handrail despite the ban on signs there.
The event operator let 160 people into a performance approved for 60. The signboard backlight was burnt out and the lease requires the stallholder to maintain it.
The vendor smoked behind the counter despite the posted ban. Separately, the market office record showed that the stall was trading while its suspension was in effect.
Sold as 3 m yung tela pero 265 cm ang measured sa tape. Separately, yung flyers ng seller told shoppers to avoid the named stall.
The vendor stacked crates against the ramp, narrowing it so a wheelchair could not pass. The operator had not reported a cracked partition as required.
Pinutol ang sealing wire ng timbangan ng tindero. Tinawag niyang kuripot ang mamimili sa post ng litrato nito.
The cook sneezed over uncovered cooked food. The seller's business permit belongs to another owner.
Tinali ni seller ang shared faucet para manatiling nakabukas. Hiwalay rito, walang SRP card sa tabi ng presyo ng asukal.
Intoxicated vendors threw bottles and nearby stalls closed. Separately, a helper left boxes on the stairs at the west end.
The owner installed new fixed cabinets before approval was granted. The active vendor had no vendor ID.
Naiwan sa shared cold room nang 9 PM ang kahon ng may-puwesto. Kailangang alisin ang stock mula sa shared cold room bago mag-8 PM. Binenta ang isda bilang 1 kilo pero tinimbang na 910 gramo.
Walang gloves yung helper habang naglalagay ng lutong pagkain sa containers kahit required ito. Nagbenta rin ng beer by the glass yung stall kahit sealed take-out lang ang allowed.
The porter hid the required rate card and accepted a delivery. Separately, the seller kept an open can of kerosene on a shelf above the vegetables.
The seller unplugged the neighboring vendor's freezer while the neighbor was away. At the seller's counter, no SRP card was displayed for basic goods.
The seller has no vendor ID. The delivery van unloaded within the allowed window.
The seller used a scale listed as condemned in the verification register. Someone said the helper left boxes on the stairs. This was not confirmed.
The helper left boxes on the stairs at the market exit. The operator's renovation matched the approved plan.
The cook spat beside the uncovered food display. The same stall's light was working.
Walang SRP card sa display ng rice. Mukhang kulang daw yung timbang, pero wala pang reweigh.
The renovation matched the approved plan. The stall's light was working at the evening inspection.
The vendor wore the required apron, cap and closed shoes. The delivery truck unloaded within the allowed window.
Gumagana ang sariling ilaw ng puwesto. Buong bayad ang nakasaad sa resibo ng market fee.
Yung isda sold as 1 kg ay measured at 1000 g. Full payment ang nasa receipt ng market fee.
No alcohol was seen at the eatery. The raffle had its approval number posted and the draw was public.
Cloth sold as 2 m measured 200 cm on the reference tape. The renovation matched the approved plan.
A tip says the stall reopened during a suspension. No record has been checked.
It is unclear whether the crates were left in the passage or picked up. The incident was not confirmed.
Nagtanong si vendor kung overdue ang rent niya. Di na-check ang ledger.
Pakisuri ang timbangan. Hindi naitimbang muli ang isda at walang tiyak na binili.
The fish weighed 920 g against a declared kilo, but the reference scale was faulty that morning.
A report said the cook spat beside the food display. This was not verified.
An inspector asked whether a porter had a rate card and whether a delivery van blocked the aisle. Neither claim was confirmed.
Baka lasing ang tindero at baka siya ang nagpatumba ng paninda. Hindi malinaw ang nangyari.
